categorical_balance.presence_scope: Anywhere in each learner's actual raw cropped environmental patch
categorical_balance.source_combination: Arithmetic mean of source factors; each source factor averages distinct present classes
limitations: Changes the training covariate distribution, rather than balancing outcomes
Presence groups overlap; this does not make every category equally frequent
Does not guarantee equal feature gradients, calibration, or improved held-out performance

heat_metadata.heat_flux_semantics: interval-mean incident radiant flux in W/m2
heat_metadata.dose_semantics: integral of interval-mean radiant flux over forecast interval in J/m2
heat_metadata.scope: newly igniting cells plus existing burning under supplied arrival and duration scenario
heat_metadata.arrival_time_assumption: conditional on a first-new-burning event, arrival is uniform within the hour
heat_metadata.burning_profile_assumption: constant conditional HRR for the supplied residence duration after arrival
heat_metadata.present_burning_assumption: activity inferred from past arrival and supplied duration on known already-burned cells
heat_metadata.activity_interval: [arrival_time_s, arrival_time_s + burning_duration_s); inactive at exact extinction
heat_metadata.unknown_probability_policy: full expectation is NaN when emitting-source activity is unresolved; nonnegative-source endpoints yield bounds
heat_metadata.unknown_current_age_policy: remaining duration in [0,T]; mean occupancy upper min(T/D,1); endpoint upper 1 if T>D, otherwise 0
heat_metadata.bounds_scope: fixed supplied combustion, duration, geometry, and finite source domain; existing fire restricted to known already-burned support; excludes existing fire hidden by unknown cumulative state, omitted transport and parameter uncertainty

predictor.probability_semantics: new cumulative burning during the next exact hour

residence_time.equation: sigma_ft_inv = sum(load * particle_sav_ft_inv**2) / sum(load * particle_sav_ft_inv); duration_s = 384 * 60 / sigma_ft_inv
residence_time.meaning: point-scale passing surface-fire flaming-front residence time
limitations: excludes indefinite trailing burning and smouldering
does not determine coarse-cell traversal time or subcell flame positions
does not establish arrival time or an active-flame observation
